svg.title: Dual connections preserve the inner product
svg.desc: Left: in the half-plane of Gaussians with coordinates mu and sigma, a vector A is carried round an ellipse by the 0.6-connection and a vector B by the minus 0.6 connection; the arrows at eight stations show they turn and stretch differently. Right: the Fisher inner product of A and B along the loop is constant for the dual pair and for Levi-Civita twice, and drifts when the same non-metric connection is used for both.
svg.text: A and B carried round a loop
The inner product of the pair
Left: the vectors are not parallel to their starting copies when they return (the pair is curved: R ≠ 0), but their inner product never moves.
Right: ⟨A, B⟩ = 0.0700 at both ends, drift 5.5·10⁻¹⁵; with one connection for both vectors it wanders by 0.0995 (the connection is not metric).
